answer: Implementation Path lists three cases (a)(b)(c), Done When counts 'Both new tests'. Satisfiable, but inconsistent. Fix: 'All three cases (a,b,c) pass and pytest tests is green.'

Inline JSON is the optional positional arg `payload` (cli/parser.py:664, help 'Inline JSON payload for the task.'), loaded via `_load_json_mapping(args.payload)` in parse_task_input (operations.py:1068-1073). No flag exists.

`payload` is already a dict in that branch: `payload = operations.parse_task_input(args)` (cli/commands/operations.py:19); parse_task_input returns dict[str,Any] (operations.py:1068). payload.get('from_drawer') is valid; no plumbing needed.

No compiler change needed. attach_drawer_source overwrites the key (operations.py:583-592) before create_task_bundle (operations.py:397-401) runs _normalize_task_payload then compile_task_bundle_spec, so compiler.py:64 copies the already-resolved path.

resolve_drawer_source (operations.py:551-581) accepts a repo-relative/absolute path, or a filename stem or unique case-insensitive slug fragment over desk/drawer/**/*.md. Existing tests use the stem, e.g. 'loose-idea' (tests/test_inbox_promote_cli_gaps.py:251).

Confirmed: exact name/stem match first, else case-insensitive substring over stems; >1 match raises ValueError 'Ambiguous drawer selector' (operations.py:574-580). task-rw-f3-drawer-routing-service only relocates these methods unchanged.
Message is `print(f"Error: {exc}")` at cli/commands/operations.py:25, i.e. 'Error: ' + the FileNotFoundError/ValueError text. Exact content need not be asserted.
Field name is `id`, optional; defaults to `task-<slug(title)>` (ops.py:1185-1191 _normalize_task_payload; compiler.py:43). Only `title` is required. The task already says 'give each task its own id'.

attach_drawer_source stores the path relative to desk_root.parent as posix and keeps `.md` (operations.py:592), i.e. `desk/drawer/tasks/task-rw-f0-x.md`; asserted as such in tests/test_inbox_promote_cli_gaps.py:256.

Convention is `<root>/desk/drawer/<subdir>/<name>.md` (tests/test_inbox_promote_cli_gaps.py:223-227, e.g. desk/drawer/tasks/task-loose-idea.md). resolve_drawer_source rglobs all of desk/drawer/, so any subfolder is valid.
